full_name: Jonathan Sterne | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2024–2025 Humanities William and Flora Hewlett Foundation Fellow McGill University (Canada)
bio: Trained in cultural studies, media studies, and historiography, Jonathan Sterne is the author of three monographs and dozens of essays that span topics in sound, media, technology, and disability.
